description: Election timetable law schedule: EXAMPLE CONTENT, not a default (D18). Used when a town enables `election_law: true` so council amendments flow through the same schedule machinery as worlds/law/schedules.json.

records.author: genesis
records.text: How the law on elections is written from its figures: polling day, the term, the notice and nomination windows, the voting window, and the handover interval before taking office.

data.title: the law on elections

first_poll_day.label: first polling day
first_poll_day.description: The day of the run on which the first poll falls, as a whole number of days.

term_days.label: length of a term
term_days.description: How long a term runs between one election and the next.

nominations_open_days.label: notice before polling day
nominations_open_days.description: How long before polling day the electoral office gives notice and opens nominations.

nominations_close_days.label: close of nominations before polling day
nominations_close_days.description: How long before polling day nominations close.

voting_days.label: voting window
voting_days.description: How long the ballot stays open, ending on polling day.

takes_office_days.label: interval before taking office
takes_office_days.description: How long after a result is declared before the declared winner takes office.

data.text: Elections for the mayor follow this timetable. << ;;The first poll falls on day {first_poll_day}.;;A term runs for {term_days}.;;Notice is given and nominations open {nominations_open_days} before polling day.;;Nominations close {nominations_close_days} before polling day.;;Voting stays open for {voting_days}.;;The declared winner takes office {takes_office_days} after the result is declared.>>

adico.attribute: the electoral office and the council clerk
adico.aim: conduct the election and seat the winner
adico.condition: <<, ;;with first poll on day {first_poll_day};;for a term of {term_days};;opening nominations {nominations_open_days} ahead;;closing nominations {nominations_close_days} ahead;;voting over {voting_days};;seating the winner {takes_office_days} after declaration>>
